segments.name: domestic site leasing
segments.description: Leases antenna space on communications towers and other sites in the United States to wireless carriers under long-term tenant leases.
segments.evidence: We derive domestic site leasing revenues primarily from T-Mobile, AT&T Wireless, and Verizon Wireless.

segments.name: international site leasing
segments.description: Owns and operates towers in international markets, leasing space to wireless carriers under long-term tenant leases.
segments.evidence: We currently own and operate towers in 12 international markets throughout South America, Central America, and Africa.

revenueModel.text: Wireless carriers pay SBA Communications rent under long-term tenant leases for space on its towers and other sites.
revenueModel.evidence: In the United States, our tenant leases are generally for an initial term of five years to ten years with multiple renewal periods at the option of the tenant.
